method: Single AI reviewer; first pixel-only assessment at literal 96 px, before reading answer key, filenames or provenance. Not a human recognition study.

portraits.cue: Closed mouth, level eyebrows and steady forward/side gaze; alert but no visible smile or distressed downturn.
Head and eyes lowered, brows drawn inward/upward, frowning downturned mouth; visibly weary and worried at 96 px.
Broad open smile with teeth, lifted cheeks and narrowed smiling eyes; unmistakably pleased at 96 px.

frames.cue: Thick dark wood rails and square corner joints; strongly heavier than all other frames.
Restrained straight rectangular frame with red inner rule.
Very faint parchment border, no dark outline, lighter than the simple thin-line panel F.
Rolled parchment ends and ornamental scroll corners without red warning rule.
Dark double straight line and tiny upper-left ornamental marker; no red.
Plain single thin brown border with flat paper body; close in semantic weight to tooltip C.
Same rolled-scroll structural family as D, plus red inner rule.
Double straight line plus bottom-right red wax seal marking completion.

portraitExposureDisclosure: Root informed reviewer after first guesses were locked that the image order accidentally matched original order and would be replaced. These guesses describe the first exposed version only; this reviewer cannot serve as a fresh blind reviewer of the replacement. Final randomized recognition requires another reviewer.
